general.name: General Tactical AI
general.description: Shared PF2e turn loop used before and after every class-specific policy.

nodes.label: Start turn
nodes.detail: Refresh reaction, MAP, action budget, and per-turn flags.

nodes.label: Can the combatant act?
nodes.detail: Check unconscious, dying, paralyzed, stunned, slowed, and quickened.

nodes.label: Resolve recovery or incapacitation
nodes.detail: Use PF2e dying and recovery rules; otherwise skip the turn.

nodes.label: Ally dying or critically wounded?
nodes.detail: Look for legal healing before stabilization; verify range and actions.

nodes.label: Use the best legal rescue
nodes.detail: Prioritize healing that restores HP. Stabilize only when no healing can save the ally.

nodes.label: Run assigned class flow
nodes.detail: Apply class resources, stances, marks, auras, companions, and action priorities.

nodes.label: Choose a legal target
nodes.detail: Respect team, taunt, line of sight, line of effect, range, and target validity.

nodes.label: Actions remaining?
nodes.detail: Never announce or resolve an action after the budget reaches zero.

nodes.label: In range with a legal path?
nodes.detail: Check reach, ranged increment, walls, occupied squares, sight, and effect.

nodes.label: Stride, Step, or seek another target
nodes.detail: Path square by square; avoid walls, unsafe flanks, and unnecessary exposure.

nodes.label: Does the target have cover?
nodes.detail: Use attacker-to-target corridor. Walls grant standard cover; larger creatures can grant lesser cover.

nodes.label: Reposition or accept cover
nodes.detail: After repeated cover-caused misses, seek a legal firing lane when the payoff exceeds the risk.

nodes.label: Can off-guard be created safely?
nodes.detail: Check a rules-legal opposite-side flank, prone, grabbed, hidden, feint, or class effect.

nodes.label: Flank or apply off-guard
nodes.detail: Do not flank into encirclement; use a trained or granted option.

nodes.label: Useful trained skill action?
nodes.detail: Demoralize uses Intimidation; Trip, Grapple, and Shove use Athletics; Tumble Through uses Acrobatics.

nodes.label: Use best skill action
nodes.detail: Compare expected condition, movement, MAP, immunities, and follow-up value.

nodes.label: Score legal actions
nodes.detail: Evaluate healing, class actions, spells, abilities, strikes, maneuvers, defense, and movement.

nodes.label: Would this be a poor third MAP attack?
nodes.detail: Prefer a useful non-attack action unless hit odds remain unusually favorable.

nodes.label: Raise Shield, Take Cover, Step, or support
nodes.detail: Take Cover only with a legal wall, obstacle, larger creature, prone ranged defense, or tower shield.

nodes.label: Resolve action completely
nodes.detail: Spend actions, roll checks, apply damage/healing/conditions, reactions, resources, recharge, and logs.

nodes.label: Encounter decided?
nodes.detail: Stop if one side has no conscious living combatants.

nodes.label: End turn
nodes.detail: Resolve persistent damage, recovery flat checks, duration changes, and hand off initiative.

invariants: Only use actions the actor actually owns or universally available trained skill actions.
Never spend more actions, reactions, focus points, spell slots, ammunition, or frequency uses than remain.
Movement, targeting, cover, line of sight, and line of effect are evaluated from current grid positions.
Class flow adjusts priorities but cannot bypass the shared legality checks.
Healing a dying ally is preferred over Stabilize whenever legal healing can restore Hit Points.
